offers_products.reason: Manufactures plant-based beverages, broths, teas, nutritional drinks and better-for-you snacks, mostly packaged for brands and retailers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured food and beverage products; 'supply chain solutions' means contract-manufactured goods, not separate services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to brands, retailers, club and foodservice customers, mostly private label; shoppers don't buy from SunOpta directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are top brands, retailers, club stores and foodservice providers buying beverages, broths and snacks.

recurring_revenue.reason: Food and beverage supply sold through repeat orders to retailers, brands and foodservice customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Staple food and beverage products such as plant milks, broths and snacks hold up in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent, repeat purchases of packaged beverages and snacks, not large infrequent buys.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured food and beverage products made in plants, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large retailers, club stores, major brands and foodservice providers across North America.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs many food and beverage manufacturing plants that need ongoing capacity and equipment investment.
